reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay helper and monthUtils.dayFromDate, which every holiday-aware code path already uses.

duplication.why: The new MM-DD matching is added once in the shared predicate; nothing is copied.

placement.why: Holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines non-working-day logic.

scope.why: A three-line change to the predicate plus targeted tests.

maintainability.why: Simple and central, though `day.slice(5)` encodes the MM-DD format implicitly without a named helper or comment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Server schedules, shared schedules and schedule templates all continue to call isNonWorkingDay.
